evals.prompt: make my github profile readme insane. my username is octocat-dev, i do android rom development and hardware reverse engineering, my color is hot pink. i listen to https://music.youtube.com/watch?v=-eGM0IJc70Y
evals.expected_output: Complete README.md using typing animation (generated by script, emoji encoded), pink-accent badges, dividers, now playing block, stats card, human-voiced about text; passes lint_readme.py with no ERR.

evals.prompt: my readme sounds like chatgpt wrote it, rewrite it so it sounds like a real person. here it is: 'I'm a passionate full-stack developer leveraging cutting-edge technologies to craft seamless experiences. 🚀 **Backend**: Node.js 🎨 **Frontend**: React'
evals.expected_output: Rewrite with specifics and voice, no em dashes or stock phrases, varied bullet shape; asks or leaves TODO for missing facts rather than inventing them.

evals.prompt: can you make a neofetch style card of my github profile with my pc specs for the readme
evals.expected_output: Explains the card must run on the user's machine for real specs, gives the exact command, and offers GitHub-only output; mentions privacy and --hide.

evals.prompt: make me a github profile readme, i'm @newdev (almost no repos, empty bio)
evals.expected_output: Does NOT build yet: asks one grouped set of questions (specialties, portfolio/links, achievements, hobbies, song link, accent color/tone) and offers a skip option; no invented facts.

evals.prompt: write a professional README for https://github.com/octocat/Hello-World with build status, stars, forks, issues and a star history graph
evals.expected_output: Clones the repo and runs scan_repo.py first; notes missing LICENSE and no CI (skips build badge or says why); uses project_badges.py; flags tiny star counts; installation/usage only from what exists; passes lint in project mode.

evals.prompt: scan my repo for anything that could get me a dmca or leaked keys before i publish, then write the readme
evals.expected_output: Runs scan_repo.py; reports masked secrets with path:line, bundled binaries/third-party/proprietary wording as review items (not accusations); says rotate keys first; offers credits table and copyright policy; says not legal advice.

evals.prompt: someone copied my repo's build scripts, write me a dmca takedown
evals.expected_output: Asks for missing facts (legal name, contact, original URLs, infringing URLs, what was copied) and checks the license permits/forbids the copying; drafts via legal_notice.py only with real facts; says the user must verify, sign and submit through GitHub; not legal advice.

evals.prompt: redo my profile with a bento layout: stats and top languages side by side, an activity graph, and my latest blog posts. blog feed is https://octo.example.dev/feed.xml
evals.expected_output: Uses the bento template; generates a stats+langs table via snippets.py pair, an activity graph in the page accent, and the blog-posts workflow with the user's feed URL and the two markers; tells the user to commit the workflow and run it once; passes lint.

evals.prompt: add a snake animation to my profile
evals.expected_output: Generates the snake workflow and the picture embed with snippets.py; explains the output branch and the manual first run; no token pasted anywhere.
